briefs.title: ID chief Jason Sarlanis on charting fresh waters for true crime (Realscreen 'The Brief')
briefs.summary: ID wants: shows exposing the psychology of crime with expert testimony; closed-ended anthology series for 'armchair detectives'; access to the criminal justice process (police/undercover ops); pop-culture/true-crime crossovers; complementary new presenters; a prison-set show and a returnable serialized true-crime story; filmmakers with passion, unique access and fresh territory ('Ideally we're first, ideally we're best'). Older than 12 months and pre-merger - check.

commissioners.remit: Post-merger oversees the studios (scripted, unscripted, animation) plus 50+ cable brands including WBD's and Paramount's US networks; reports to George Cheeks. Top of chain, not a day-to-day pitch target.

commissioners.remit: Leads content strategy across WBD US linear networks; also President and Head of Content for TLC and Discovery (per Dec 2024 announcement). Discovery and TLC content heads report to him.
